title: File access built from input (haskell) — review required
description: A haskell file operation builds its path from input: readFile (dir ++ f). Traversal sequences escape the directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms confinement via canonicalize plus prefix check.
remediation: Confine with canonicalize plus prefix check or map input through an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any input-built path matches.
